A nonpartisan primary , top-two primary , [ 1 ] or jungle primary [ 2 ] is a primary election in which all candidates for the same elected office run against each other at once, regardless of political party. This distinguishes them from partisan primaries, which are segregated by political party. This is the first round of a two-round system . As opposed to most two-round systems, the "first round" is a primary held before Election Day, and the "second round" is not optional (most two-round systems skip the second round if the winner of the first one gets more than 50%). A two-round system where the first round is held on Election Day is known in the US as runoff voting or top-two runoff .
